shard.title: battery: battery-sphedind
shard.basis: members of group battery-sphedind (origin rule) in the current release (7224r3a)

name: sphedocc
label: Spouse's Father's occ when spouse was 16

questions.text:
A. Now we would like to find out what kind of work your (husband's/wife's) father (OR SUBSTITUTE) did when your (husband/wife) was about 16 years old. What kind of work was your (husband's/wife's) father (OR SUBSTITUTE) doing? That is, what was (his/her) job called?
B. IF NOT ALREADY ANSWERED, ASK:  What did (he/she) actually do in that job?  Tell me what were some of  (his/her) main duties?
C. What kind of place did (he/she) work for?
D. IF NOT ALREADY ANSWERED, ASK:  What did they (make/do)?
E. IF ALREADY ANSWERED, CODE WITHOUT ASKING:  Was (he/she) self-employed or did (he/she) work for someone else?
